plainEnglish.summary: Users must not be forced to solve puzzles, recall passwords, or perform mental math to complete tasks unless an alternative login/verification method exists.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Cognitive tests like CAPTCHAs lock out users with memory loss, dyslexia, or brain injuries.
plainEnglish.realWorldExample: Offering passkeys, SMS single-use codes, or email magic links alongside standard password login.

personaBreakdown.designer: Design passwordless login options (passkeys, magic links).
personaBreakdown.developer: Ensure input fields allow copy-pasting passwords and integrate WebAuthn API.
personaBreakdown.qa: Verify CAPTCHA alternatives (like Cloudflare Turnstile or audio/email options) work.
personaBreakdown.productManager: Incorporate WebAuthn passkey support in product roadmap.

statusSummary.workingGroupDebate: W3C consensus is high due to the rise of WebAuthn and passkeys replacing traditional passwords.
statusSummary.keyChallenges: Ensuring security compliance while eliminating cognitive friction.

testingGuide.automated: Check for `onpaste="return false"` on input fields.
testingGuide.screenReader: Test screen reader speech during authentication flows.

wcag22Comparison.deltaExplanation: Directly carries forward WCAG 2.2 3.3.8 into the cognitive task outcome area.
